## Summary

Adds the first filled matrix pass for the Agent → MCP Server boundary: `working-documents/agent-mcp-server-boundary-deep-dive.md`.

The document delivers issue #29's requested deliverable for this boundary, aligned with the gap-analysis work package in the cross-boundary observability model draft (PR #25, Section 8.4):

- Fills all eight matrix fields (Identity, Context, Relationship, Lifecycle, Outcome, Provenance, Security, Timing) with concrete proposals for the Agent → MCP Server boundary
- Maps each field to existing coverage (MCP spec, OTel GenAI MCP conventions, WG PRIOR-WORK.md landscape) versus open gaps
- Flags the load-bearing open gaps: declared vs observed divergence, evidence integrity, server-side side-effect manifests, consent-chain observability
- Includes a generic worked scenario of the declared-vs-observed gap in Section 5, naming no product, written to hold for any implementation that satisfies the field table
- Proposes coordinate-first upstream recommendations (OTel GenAI SIG, A2A/AGNTCY) and four review questions for the WG

## Related Issue

Updates #29 (first boundary deep-dive; further boundaries can follow the same pattern)

## Review Notes

- The filled matrix row in Section 3 is designed to be lifted directly into the seed matrix in `working-documents/cross-boundary-observability-model.md` (PR #25) once reviewers are satisfied
- Coverage claims trace to PRIOR-WORK.md citations and the MCP protocol specification. No implementation is named or recommended: the pass states requirements and gaps, and any named project would need independent selection and review by the WG
- Suggested review window: before the next WG call, so any accepted changes can flow into the call discussion

## Follow-ups

- If accepted, merge the filled row into the seed matrix (PR #25 follow-up or direct edit)
- Convert open gaps into upstream action items (Section 6)
- Consider follow-up deep-dives for the other unfilled boundaries (Agent → A2A Peer, Agent → Gateway or Runtime)

## Checklist

- [x] Linked the relevant issue, meeting note, or action item
- [ ] Updated issue status or next step if needed
- [x] Added or updated a freshness/status marker for living documents, if applicable
